---
title: "Border Quarantine and the Delta Variant"
---
This website presents a data story about how vaccine efficacy and viral transmissibility shape the performance of border quarantine systems during the COVID-19 Delta wave.

It is completed as part of the ETC5523 Communicating with Data assessment at Monash University.

### Explore the site

- **Blog**: Read the full analysis of quarantine performance under Delta
- **About**: Learn more about the author

The analysis is based on a 2022 modelling study of the Australian border quarantine system, adapted for a non-technical audience.
